best_num = 0.0
best_den = 1.0

for i in range(1, int(n) + 1):
    ratio = x / y
    a = int(ratio * i // 1)  # floor
    t = int((ratio * i + 0.9999999999999999) // 1)  # ceil approximation

    if abs(ratio - a / i) < abs(ratio - best_num / best_den):
        best_num = a
        best_den = i
    if abs(ratio - t / i) < abs(ratio - best_num / best_den):

        best_den = i
